name: crossval-plan-vs-actual
description: CrossVal Plan vs Actual Tracker monorepo

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @crossval/contracts run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @crossval/contracts --filter @crossval/api --filter @crossval/web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @crossval/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @crossval/api run build && pnpm --filter @crossval/web run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @crossval/contracts run build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @crossval/contracts run build && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
